paper_title: Counterfactual Influence as a Distributional Quantity
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the training and validation accuracy over 30 epochs during the training of a model. The x-axis, labeled "Epoch," ranges from 0 to 30 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)", ranges from 40 to 100 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 10. Two lines are plotted: a solid blue line representing "Train" accuracy and a solid green line representing "Validation" accuracy. The train accuracy starts at approximately 45% at epoch 0, exhibits significant fluctuations with sharp peaks and troughs, dips to around 40% at epoch 10, then rises steeply to reach 100% by epoch 25 and remains there through epoch 30. The validation accuracy also begins near 45%, shows similar but less extreme fluctuations, dips to about 40% at epoch 10, and gradually increases to approximately 82% by epoch 30. Both lines show increasing trends overall, though the train accuracy increases more rapidly and reaches a higher final value than the validation accuracy.
